extensionAttribute.description: Returns the ParentAddress (SEC server) from /Library/Sophos Anti-Virus/RMS/router.config so you can verify the management server the agent is actually talking to.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Sophos RMS Configuration Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
config="/Library/Sophos Anti-Virus/RMS/router.config"
if [[ -f "$config" ]]; then parent=$(/usr/bin/awk -F'=' '/ParentAddress/ { print $2; exit }' "$config" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//') echo "<result>${parent:-Not Set}</result>" else echo "<result>Not installed</result>" fi
